curriculum: ACA Phase Two Six-Week Curriculum Master v2.0
title: Find the Need and Establish the Evidence

guided_audio_chapters: Begin with a person, not a product
The symptom and the possible causes

applied_work.prompt: Help distinguish symptoms, possible causes and assumptions in these notes. Suggest five neutral questions to test the need. Do not present audience preferences as established facts. Notes: [sanitized project notes].
ai_workflow: Learner opens chosen AI tool on phone, tablet, or computer
Learner pastes the approved prompt with sanitized notes
Learner checks five proposed questions for leading assumptions
Learner revises questions, brings analysis back to Academy
Learner records provisional choice, uncertainty and conditions to change it

completion_checks: Name what evidence would change provisional selection
Explain why an AI-suggested tool is not proof of demand
implementation_notes: New lesson retains all 1.1 project evidence; do not overwrite. Original course published state remains unchanged until approved media, authenticated integration and founder review.
